description: Template for a private network reached over WebTransport. Copy it to another name in this directory and fill in the values from the deploy; only dev.json and example.json are tracked, so the copy stays local. A copy may add bootstrapProtocols, a list of UDP, TCP, WS, WSS and WTS in the order a bare name or address in bootstrap is dialed over.
networkKey: the network key password the deploy was built with
